issues.description: install.sh version guard still uses -lt 7, allowing Python 3.7-3.9 through despite the 3.10 minimum
issues.detail: The error message says Python >=3.10 is required, but the guard `PYTHON_MINOR_VER -lt 7` still accepts 3.7, 3.8, and 3.9. Users on those versions silently pass the check and then fail downstream in confusing ways. Change the comparison to `-lt 10` to match pyproject's requires-python and the printed message.

issues.description: Stale `default_raise` helper and `< 3.10 compatibility` comments remain in wallet_request_types.py
issues.detail: With kw_only=True now unconditional, `default_raise` and its `field(default_factory=default_raise)` callers are no longer needed, and the comment claiming they exist `for < 3.10 compatibility` is misleading. Either remove the helper in favor of plain required kw-only fields, or update the rationale so future readers aren't confused.

issues.description: Amazon/Rocky CI prep adds noisy `dnf search python3.12` and full `dnf update -y`
issues.detail: `dnf search` is a diagnostic no-op that adds log noise and can return non-zero, while `dnf update -y` performs a full system upgrade on every run, slowing CI and risking drift. Drop the search and prefer a targeted `dnf install -y git python3.12` instead.

issues.description: Ruff UP007/UP035/UP045 globally ignored, deferring the PR's stated Union/Optional migration
issues.detail: ruff.toml adds blanket ignores for the very rules that enforce PEP 604 syntax the PR description motivates. With only a bare TODO and no tracking issue or owner, these suppressions are likely to become permanent. Link a tracking issue or apply the rewrites incrementally rather than landing an open-ended escape hatch.

issues.description: Verify `itertools` is imported after switching to `itertools.pairwise` in test_priority_mutex.py
issues.detail: The change replaces `zip(ordered, ordered[1:])` with `itertools.pairwise(ordered)`, which requires `import itertools` at module scope. The diff doesn't show the import being added, so if it isn't already present the test will raise NameError. Quick confirmation needed.

issues.description: Sweep remaining stale `3.9` / `< 3.10` references across the codebase
issues.detail: Comments and pragmas referencing 3.9 quirks were only partially removed (e.g., conditions.py pragma cleaned, but wallet_request_types.py rationale remains). A targeted grep for `3.9` and `< 3.10` would catch the rest so the drop is consistent across files.

synthesis.summary: The panel agrees this PR cleanly drops Python 3.9 across CI matrices, install scripts, packaging, and version-gated dataclass shims. Three P1 issues are unanimous: install.sh's `-lt 7` guard still allows 3.7-3.9 despite the new 3.10 minimum, `default_raise` and `< 3.10 compatibility` comments remain stale in wallet_request_types.py, and the Amazon/Rocky CI prep steps include a noisy `dnf search` plus a full `dnf update -y`. P2 concerns: ruff.toml broadly ignores UP007/UP035/UP045, deferring the Union/Optional migration the PR motivates, the itertools.pairwise change should have its import verified, and a few stale 3.9 references remain elsewhere.
